The Battle of Gaza may refer to multiple conflicts throughout history, but the most notable include the battles between Egypt and Macedon, Hasmonean Judea and Gaza/Nabateans, the Crusaders and the Ayyubids, and the Ottoman victory over the British. 

The Battle of Gaza of 2007 was a pivotal event in the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

The battle has been a recurring theme in the Middle East, with various dynasties and empires fighting for control. The legacy of the Battle of Gaza can be seen in the ongoing struggles for power and territory in the region. 

The 2007 battle marked a significant escalation of violence in the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, with a lasting impact on the politics of the region.
